description: Ben Stokes to Jhye Richardson. Length ball, outside off stump on the back foot pushing, to mid on for no runs, fielded by Duckett.
commentary: Ben Stokes to Jhye Richardson. Length ball, outside off stump on the back foot pushing, to mid on for no runs, fielded by Duckett.

description: Ben Stokes to Jhye Richardson. Short pitched delivery, pulled down to mid wicket for two runs.
commentary: Short pitched delivery. Richardson pulls it down the ground for a comfortable two.

description: Ben Stokes to Jhye Richardson. Back of length, just outside off. Jhye Richardson leaves it alone.
commentary: Back of length, just outside off. Richardson has a look at it and leaves.

description: Ben Stokes to Jhye Richardson. Full toss, pulled over deep square leg for six runs.
commentary: Full toss! Richardson gets underneath it and smashes it over deep square leg for six!

description: Ben Stokes to Jhye Richardson. Good length delivery on off stump, covers the line and drives to cover for a single.
commentary: Good line and length. Richardson closes the face and works it to cover for one.

description: Mark Wood to Marnus Labuschagne. Pace on, short of length, Labuschagne sways away from it.
commentary: Mark Wood bowls short and quick. Labuschagne ducks underneath.

description: Mark Wood to Marnus Labuschagne. Full length, swinging in towards leg stump. Labuschagne misses the line and is lbw.
commentary: Mark Wood bowls full and swings it in! Labuschagne is out lbw!

description: Mark Wood to Steve Smith. Good length, on off stump. Smith shoulders arms.
commentary: Good bowling from Mark Wood. Smith leaves that one alone.

description: Mark Wood to Steve Smith. Short ball, Smith pulls it to fine leg for three runs.
commentary: Smith takes the short ball on and pulls it to fine leg for three.
